data.comment:
# Comfy FLUX 3 Image- Image Edit

Edit or combine up to ten reference images from a text instruction with FLUX 3 Image, referring to them in the prompt as image 1, image 2, and so on. One image is output at any of sixteen aspect ratios and up to 4K, with web and image search grounding on by default. Ideal for character-consistent edits, product and object placement, and multi-reference scene compositing. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_bfl_flux3_image_edit.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
